title: MDMC Relawan Platform
description: Platform pengelolaan data relawan MDMC yang aman, terstruktur, dan siap mendukung koordinasi kebencanaan dari daerah hingga tingkat nasional.

case_study.role: Full Lifecycle AI Engineering & UX Design
case_study.challenge: Modern leadership teams face decision fragmentation caused by disconnected data sources and sluggish reporting pipelines.
case_study.solution: Constructed an end-to-end multi-agent orchestration pipeline with vector database indexing, hybrid semantic search, and streaming analytics with sub-second latency.
results: Demonstrated 72% reduction in query resolution latency during benchmark testing
Implemented zero-leakage enterprise data partitioning with strict RLS
Built full streaming markdown parser with interactive artifact execution
